axis_note: Two axes. Timing of OpenAI's listing: +1 towards a delay, -1 towards a listing. Market conditions: +1 adverse, -1 favourable. Each signal pushes one axis by one step; the needle is the sum on each axis, normalised. Anthropic is shown as a separate marker.
